ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 12
   D. 10

2. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 12

3. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 24
   C. 11
   D. 25

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 12

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 170

7. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

8. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 37

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 82

10. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 20

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

14. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 0

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

16. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
